cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
When running the SDK tests, we get "too many open files" error

Steps

- Run MeiliSearch with a master key:
```
cargo run --release -- --master-key=masterKey
```

- Clone the meilisearch-js repo and run the tests
```
git clone git@github.com:meilisearch/meilisearch-js.git
cd meilisearch-js
yarn
yarn test
```

On macOS
The bug was not present in v0.22.0

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix too many open file error
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix too many open file error

- prepare_for_closing() function wasn't called when an index is deleted, we are now calling it
- Index wasn't deleted in the case where we couldn't insert `uid` in `index_uuid_store`, we are now cleaning it

Fix #1736
